confirmedFindings.title: Nonce Consumed After Verification Opens Replay Window
confirmedFindings.body: Checking and consuming the authentication nonce after completing hash verification opens a race window where multiple parallel requests can replay the same nonce simultaneously before it is added to consumedNonces.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Atomically mark the nonce as consumed before verifying the cryptographic digest.
